message.content:
Here’s a classic list of ingredients you’ll need to bake a delicious chocolate cake:

| Ingredient | Quantity | Notes |
|------------|----------|-------|
| All‑purpose flour | 1 ¾ cups (220 g) | Sifted for a lighter crumb |
| Granulated sugar | 2 cups (400 g) | White or brown, depending on sweetness |
| Unsweetened cocoa powder | ¾ cup (75 g) | Dutch‑process or natural, sifted |
| Baking soda | 1 tsp (5 g) | Works with acidic cocoa |
| Baking powder | 1 tsp (5 g) | Adds lift |
| Salt | ½ tsp (2.5 g) | Enhances flavor |
| Eggs | 2 large | Room temperature |
| Whole milk | 1 cup (240 ml) | Room temperature |
| Vegetable oil | ½ cup (120 ml) | Or melted butter for richer flavor |
| Vanilla extract | 2 tsp (10 ml) | Pure vanilla for depth |
| Boiling water | 1 cup (240 ml) | Activates cocoa, creates moist crumb |
| Optional: buttermilk | ½ cup (120 ml) | For extra tenderness |

**Optional extras for flavor or texture:**
- **Coffee** (1–2 tsp) – intensifies chocolate taste
- **Chocolate chips** (½ cup) – for a chocolate‑chip cake
- **Almond extract** (½ tsp) – subtle nutty note
- **Cocoa nibs** (¼ cup) – crunchy texture

**Tips:**
- Use a good quality cocoa powder; it makes a big difference.
- Make sure all dry ingredients are sifted together to avoid lumps.
- Add boiling water last to keep batter smooth.
- Bake at 350 °F (175 °C) for about 30–35 min, or until a toothpick comes out clean.

Enjoy your baking!
